support.note: Core exposes only deterministic base movement, unrestricted ground-and-air targeting and attack cadence. Hero abilities, equipment, pets and defending-altar behavior remain absent.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only Hero L1-L105 with no Core identifier, direct-damage values or TH18 L106-L110 records.
changed_values.replacement: The current TH18 base-attack slice L101-L110 has a hash-pinned L106-L110 observation and current DPS-derived impact values.
changed_values.justification: The cited current table and official TH18 level announcement suffice for a narrow direct-attack integration, not a complete Hero contract.

known_uncertainties: No primary source publishes Queen base HP, damage, attack cadence or target details. The current numeric source is secondary and warns that hero records could not be independently cross-checked.

No consulted source provides projectile speed, launch, flight, collision, loss-of-target timing, radius, wall interaction or source-verified visual placement. A logical projectile is not enabled until such a contract exists.
Hero abilities, equipment, pets, altar wake range, defending-hero state, regeneration, ability buttons, healing, invisibility, spawned units and spell interactions remain excluded or disabled.
conclusion: Archer Queen L101-L110 base attack data is source-traced and ready for the shared deterministic integration. It is not presented as a complete Hero until abilities, defensive state, geometry, assets and the remaining verified mechanics are available.
